about: The deliverable tiers of a standardised design system, lowest first. A tier is reached when every core decision of the tier (references/standard-decisions.json) is held or recorded and its artifacts are in the repository. It is only claimed when some of those decisions rest on a check the audit did not re-run. Tiers have names, not numbers of their own: `maps_to` gives the level in the owner's architecture note (L1 to L5), where conformance (L4) is the exit condition of every tier rather than a tier. `terms` are vocabulary terms. Artifacts are named by the path the acceptance kit reads them from.
